note: Budgets the Nex briefing workflow enforces. Nex also enforces its own chat limits (depth 3, 8 live sub-chats per conversation); these stay below them.

token_budget.note: Fresh tokens = uncached input + output, as the provider reports them per request. Best-effort: checked after each reported request and about once a minute, so a request in flight can overshoot.
token_budget.reserve_note: Held back from research for the stages every report needs. New research may start only if, with every running agent spending its whole cap plus the in-flight margin, the reserve stays untouched.
